name: Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA)
description: Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) provides public APIs and data services for satellite Earth observation data, including GCOM/ALOS satellite imagery, global precipitation mapping, greenhouse gas monitoring, and scientific mission data from Japanese space programs.

itemOffered.name: JAXA Earth API
itemOffered.description: Provides access to over 100 Earth observation satellite datasets from JAXA missions including ALOS, GCOM-C, and GCOM-W. Delivers data in Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) format through a STAC-compatible catalog. Supports Python and JavaScript clients for acquisition, processing, and visualization of satellite imagery covering elevation, surface temperature, vegetation index, precipitation, and land cover.

itemOffered.name: G-Portal Web API
itemOffered.description: OGC-compliant web services for searching and accessing JAXA Earth observation satellite products from missions including GCOM-W (AMSR2), GCOM-C (SGLI), and GSMaP precipitation products. Provides Catalog Services for the Web (CSW), Web Map Service (WMS), and Web Coverage Service (WCS).

itemOffered.name: GSMaP Global Rainfall Watch API
itemOffered.description: Provides global satellite-based precipitation estimates through the Global Satellite Mapping of Precipitation (GSMaP) product. Delivers near-real-time and archive rainfall rate data at 0.1-degree resolution updated every 30 minutes.

itemOffered.name: ALOS User Interface Gateway 2 (AUIG2)
itemOffered.description: Online search and ordering system for ALOS and ALOS-2 synthetic aperture radar and optical observation data.

itemOffered.name: JAXA Himawari P-Tree Data Service
itemOffered.description: Provides near-real-time and archive access to Himawari geostationary meteorological satellite imagery and derived products via FTP.

subjectOf.name: GCOM-C (SGLI) - Satellite Data
subjectOf.description: Global Change Observation Mission - Climate satellite data including land surface temperature, sea surface temperature, and in-water properties at 250m resolution.

subjectOf.name: GCOM-W (AMSR2) - Satellite Data
subjectOf.description: Global Change Observation Mission - Water satellite data including sea ice concentration, soil moisture, and precipitation.

subjectOf.name: GSMaP - Global Satellite Mapping of Precipitation
subjectOf.description: Near-real-time and archive global precipitation data at 0.1-degree resolution updated every 30 minutes.

subjectOf.name: ALOS/ALOS-2 - Advanced Land Observing Satellite Data
subjectOf.description: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and optical observation data from ALOS and ALOS-2 satellites.
